description: LUNATHEGOAT builds LUNARSEYE for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge: a web tool that uses NASA LOLA terrain and SPICE geometry to compute terrain-aware sunlight and Earth line of sight for 27 south-pole candidate sites, then recommends one site for a mission's needs, with the source of every number. Live: lunarseye.onrender.com. Team of two: frontend + research, backend + algorithm.
